description_en: Retrieves the current configuration of a workflow template in a collaboration workspace
description_zh: 有效成员读取协作空间工作流模板当前配置
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo get-workflow-template --collaboration-group-id cg_9401 --template-id tpl_9401 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetWorkflowTemplate

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the template to read. The format is a lowercase v followed by a positive integer, such as v1. If not specified, the effective version is used. If no effective version exists, the latest version is used
parameters.help_zh: 要读取的模板版本号，格式为小写 v + 正整数，例如 v1；不传时取生效版本，无生效版本时取最新版本
parameters.name: version

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

createdByUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator

description.example: 处理客户投诉的标准流程

edges.description_en: The node dependency edges. Each item contains from and to fields that reference stable step IDs. An explicit empty array indicates no dependencies
edges.description_zh: 节点依赖边；每项包含from/to，引用稳定stepId；显式空数组表示没有依赖

items.description_en: A node dependency edge. The from field is the step ID of the predecessor node, and the to field is the step ID of the successor node
items.description_zh: 一条节点依赖边，from为前置节点stepId，to为后置节点stepId

effectiveVersion.description_en: The current effective version number of the template. An empty value indicates that only a draft exists and the template cannot be used for work items
effectiveVersion.description_zh: 模板当前生效版本号；为空表示仅有草稿、不可用于工作项

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

gmtModified.description_en: The modification time in ISO 8601 format

layout.description_en: The optional canvas layout, indexed by step ID. This only affects the display and does not determine dependencies
layout.description_zh: 可选画布布局，按stepId索引；只影响展示，不决定依赖

schemaVersion.description_en: The schema version of the template. The current value is 2, which is independent of the business version vN
schemaVersion.description_zh: 模板结构版本，当前为2，与业务版本vN独立

items.example: {"modelMode":"standard","name":"客户投诉处理流程","ownerAgentName":"example","ownerType":"MEMBER","ownerUserId":1,"reviewOutput":false,"reviewerUserIds":[10086],"sortOrder":1,"specification":"收集客户信息，交给负责人审核","specificationJson":[{"type":"text","content":"整理输入资料"}],"stepId":"collect"}

ownerAgentName.description_en: The name of the agent owner

ownerType.description_en: The owner type. Valid values: MEMBER: Human. AGENT: Agent
ownerType.description_zh: 负责人类型：MEMBER 人工 / AGENT 智能体

ownerUserId.description_en: The user ID of the human owner

reviewOutput.description_en: Specifies whether the output is manually reviewed. Default value: false. This feature can only be enabled for digital workers, and review to-do items are automatically sent to the owner
reviewOutput.description_zh: 是否人工审核产出物，默认关闭；仅数字员工可开启，审核待办自动发负责人

reviewerUserIds.description_en: The list of user IDs of the reviewers

items.description_en: The list of user IDs of the reviewers

sortOrder.description_en: The sort order of the step

specification.description_en: The processing instructions for the step
specification.example: 收集客户信息，交给负责人审核

specificationJson.description_en: The structured segment array for the step instructions. Supports text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. The fields and nested attachments of each segment are preserved as returned by the backend
specificationJson.description_zh: 步骤说明结构化片段数组，支持 text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；各片段字段及嵌套附件按后端原样保留

items.description_en: The structured segment array for the step instructions. Supports text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. The fields and nested attachments of each segment are preserved as returned by the backend
items.description_zh: 步骤说明结构化片段数组，支持 text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；各片段字段及嵌套附件按后端原样保留

versionStatus.description_en: The version status. Valid values: DRAFT: Draft. SUBMITTED: Submitted
versionStatus.description_zh: 版本状态：DRAFT 草稿 / SUBMITTED 已提交
